fullDescription: A restrained, light hero-image carousel: one large 16:9 active frame flanked by soft-faded peek frames, a thin emerald progress bar, stretched-pill dot indicators, and a thumbnail strip, all on near-white surfaces with a single emerald accent and Inter type.

structured.summary: A calm, light, editorial product page for an AI design agent's prompt library, anchored by a restrained hero-image carousel: one large 16:9 active frame flanked by two narrow soft-faded 3:4 peek frames, with a thin emerald progress bar, capsule dot indicators (the active dot stretched into a pill), and a five-up thumbnail strip below. Built on near-white surfaces, slate text, and a single emerald accent. Sections (sticky blurred nav, centered hero, the carousel showcase on a neutral rounded canvas, a three-card variants strip, a two-column specs grid, a dark emerald-glow prompt CTA, and a minimal footer) all sit inside a centered max-w-7xl column and reflow cleanly to a single stack on mobile.

style.description: Light, airy, restrained editorial UI. Surfaces are white (#ffffff) and a very faint slate gradient (slate-50 #f8fafc to white) on rounded 28px canvases; all text is slate (slate-900 #0f172a headings, slate-600 #475569 nav, slate-500 #64748b body); a single emerald accent runs through the brand dot, controls, eyebrows, progress bar, the active indicator, and CTAs (emerald-500 #10b981 primary, emerald-600 #059669 hover, emerald-300 #6ee7b7 / emerald-50 #ecfdf5 / emerald-100 #d1fae5 / emerald-200 #a7f3d0 tints). Depth is soft and quiet: large soft drop shadows (slide = 0 30px 60px -18px rgba(15,23,42,0.28) + 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.18); peek = 0 18px 40px -22px rgba(15,23,42,0.22)) and a colored control glow (ctrl = 0 10px 30px -8px rgba(16,185,129,0.45)); hairline borders are slate-200 (#e2e8f0) and ring-black/5; corners are generously rounded (rounded-full pills, rounded-2xl cards, rounded-[20px]/[28px] frames and canvases). A faint dotted 'grain' texture (radial-gradient rgba(15,23,42,0.025) 1px dots on a 22px grid) sits behind the hero and inside the showcase canvas. A blurred emerald-100/60 radial glow floats above the hero. Type is Inter throughout (300-900), with extrabold tracking-tight display headings (text-balance), uppercase wide-tracked emerald eyebrows ([0.18em]), and relaxed slate body copy. Slide transitions use a 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) ease.
style.prompt: Design a light, restrained, editorial UI. Palette EXACTLY: white background #ffffff with a faint slate-50 #f8fafc to white gradient on inner canvases; text slate-900 #0f172a for headings, slate-600 #475569 for nav/links, slate-500 #64748b for body, slate-400 #94a3b8 and slate-300 #cbd5e1 for muted/inactive; hairline borders slate-200 #e2e8f0; single accent emerald with emerald-500 #10b981 as the primary, emerald-600 #059669 as hover, emerald-700 #047857 / emerald-300 #6ee7b7 for text-on-dark and supporting, and tints emerald-50 #ecfdf5, emerald-100 #d1fae5, emerald-200 #a7f3d0 for badge/icon backgrounds and glows. One dark band only: slate-900 #0f172a CTA with emerald-500/20 and emerald-400/10 blurred glows. Font: Inter for everything (weights 300-900). Headings are font-extrabold, tracking-tight, leading ~1.05, text-balance; eyebrows are 11px uppercase font-bold with letter-spacing 0.18em in emerald-600; body is text-pretty leading-relaxed slate-500. Shadows are soft and large, never hard: slide = 0 30px 60px -18px rgba(15,23,42,0.28), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.18); peek = 0 18px 40px -22px rgba(15,23,42,0.22); and a colored control glow ctrl = 0 10px 30px -8px rgba(16,185,129,0.45) on emerald buttons. Corners are generously rounded: rounded-full pills/badges/arrows, rounded-2xl cards, rounded-[20px] active frame, rounded-[28px] outer canvas + CTA. Add a faint dotted 'grain' backdrop: radial-gradient(rgba(15,23,42,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px) at 22px x 22px, behind the hero and inside the showcase canvas; float a blurred emerald-100/60 radial glow above the hero. Slide motion: transition transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1). Tone: quiet, confident, premium-minimal. Icons exclusively Iconify Phosphor 'bold' weight (e.g. ph:caret-left-bold, ph:caret-right-bold, ph:slideshow-bold, ph:sparkle-bold).

layout_and_structure.description: A single centered max-w-7xl column with px-6 (mobile) / px-8 (lg) gutters. Order top to bottom: a sticky blurred white nav, a centered hero (eyebrow badge + balanced headline + sub), the carousel SHOWCASE on a rounded neutral canvas (the anchor of the layout: caption row, a center-stage active 16:9 frame flanked by two narrow 3:4 peek frames, a thin progress bar, a dot indicator row, and a 5-up thumbnail strip), a bordered slate-50 'variants' band with a 3-card grid, a two-column 'specs' grid (intro column + 2x2 feature cards), a dark slate-900 'prompt' CTA card, and a minimal footer. Desktop multi-column grids and the side peek frames / desktop nav links collapse on mobile; the active frame goes full-width with the peeks hidden under sm.

prompts.prompt: Sticky top nav (z-50), 64px tall, white/80 background with backdrop-blur-xl and a hairline slate-200/70 bottom border, contents inside the centered max-w-7xl column with px-6/px-8 gutters. Left: an 8x8 rounded-lg emerald-500 tile carrying the ctrl glow shadow and a white ph:slideshow-bold icon, beside a 15px font-extrabold tracking-tight wordmark 'Carousel' + an emerald-500 '.' + 'Design'. Center (md+ only): four slate-600 14px font-medium links (Showcase, Variants, Specs, Prompt) that darken to slate-900 on hover. Right: a lg-only slate-600 'Browse library' text link and a primary pill button 'Open in canvas' (rounded-full, slate-900 fill, white text, hover:bg-emerald-600) with a ph:arrow-up-right-bold icon that nudges +0.5 on hover; the label collapses to 'Open' under sm.

Centered hero inside a relative overflow-hidden section, padded pt-16/pt-20 and pb-6. Behind it: the faint dotted 'grain' backdrop and a blurred emerald-100/60 radial glow (h-72, w-680px) floating above center. Content centered in a max-w-7xl column: a small rounded-full badge (emerald-200 border, emerald-50 fill, emerald-700 text, 12px font-semibold) with a pinging emerald dot (an absolute animate-ping emerald-400/75 ring over a solid emerald-500 dot) reading 'Prompt library · UI component'; then a balanced extrabold tracking-tight h1 up to max-w-3xl, leading-[1.05], scaling 4xl -> sm:5xl -> lg:6xl, reading 'The hero image carousel, done with restraint.' with 'restraint' in emerald-500; then a max-w-xl text-pretty slate-500 sub at base -> sm:text-lg, leading-relaxed: 'One large active frame, a quiet peek of what's next, and controls that get out of the way. Generated from a single prompt, ready to drop onto your canvas.'

The centerpiece. Inside the max-w-7xl column (pb-20), a relative overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] neutral canvas with a slate-200 border, a slate-50 -> white vertical gradient, an inset white top-highlight shadow, and the faint dotted 'grain' at 60% opacity; padding px-4/py-10 -> sm:px-10/sm:py-14. CAPTION ROW (max-w-5xl, items-end justify-between): left = an emerald-600 11px uppercase eyebrow 'Featured · 03 of 05' over a slate-900 xl/2xl font-bold title 'Frost over the valley'; right (sm+ only) = a rounded-full slate-200-bordered white chip with an emerald-500 ph:image-square-bold icon + '1920 x 1080'. STAGE (max-w-5xl): a flex row, items-center justify-center, gap-3 -> sm:gap-5. A LEFT PEEK frame (sm+ only): aspect-[3/4], w-13%, flex-none, rounded-2xl, opacity-85, peek shadow, ring-1 ring-black/5, holding a cover image scaled 110% with a left-to-right white/55 -> white/15 fade overlay. The ACTIVE slide: a group figure, aspect-[16/9], flex-1, rounded-[20px], slide shadow, ring-1 ring-black/5, holding a full cover image, a bottom slate-900/45 -> transparent gradient scrim, a left prev arrow (11x11 rounded-full white/90, slate-700, backdrop-blur, shadow-lg, hover -> emerald-500/white, ph:caret-left-bold) and a right next arrow (emerald-500 fill, white, ctrl glow, hover:emerald-600, ph:caret-right-bold), both vertically centered, and a bottom figcaption (items-end justify-between, p-5/p-6): left = an emerald-300 11px uppercase 'Landscape' eyebrow over a white base/lg font-semibold 'Glacier National Park, dawn'; right = a rounded-full white/15 backdrop-blur chip 'ph:heart-bold 2.4k'. A RIGHT PEEK frame mirrors the left (right-to-left fade). PROGRESS BAR: centered mt-7, h-1, max-w-xs/sm, rounded-full slate-200 track with a 60%-wide emerald-500 fill. DOT INDICATORS: centered mt-5 row, gap-2.5, of five h-2 dots; inactive are w-2 rounded-full slate-300 (hover slate-400), the active (3rd) is a stretched w-7 emerald-500 pill. THUMBNAIL STRIP: centered mt-9 row (max-w-3xl), gap-3, of five aspect-[16/10] rounded-lg thumbnails (w-16 -> sm:w-20) at opacity-60 with ring-1 ring-black/5 (hover -> opacity-100); the active (3rd) is larger (w-20 -> sm:w-24), full opacity, with a ring-2 ring-emerald-500 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-white.

A full-bleed band with slate-200 top+bottom borders and a slate-50/70 fill, contents in the max-w-7xl column (py-16). Header row (flex-col -> sm:flex-row, items-end justify-between): left = an emerald-600 11px uppercase eyebrow 'Same prompt, three moods' over a slate-900 2xl/3xl font-extrabold 'Variants you can fork'; right = an emerald-600 14px font-semibold link 'See all 24 layouts' with a ph:arrow-right-bold that nudges on hover. Below: a responsive 3-col card grid (1 -> sm:2 -> lg:3, gap-6). Each card is a group rounded-2xl white article with a slate-200 border + peek shadow that lifts (-translate-y-1) to the slide shadow on hover, with an aspect-[16/10] overflow-hidden image header (image scales 105% on hover) and a p-5 footer row (a slate-900 text-sm font-bold title + a slate-500 text-xs sub, plus a slate-300 ph:arrow-up-right-bold that turns emerald-500 on hover). Card 1 'Full-bleed hero' (overlay caption, with three white progress-dot pills bottom-left over the image). Card 2 'Center + peek' (a literal mini center+peek layout: a slate-100 stage holding a faded narrow 3:4 left frame, a shadowed 16:10 center frame, and a faded narrow 3:4 right frame). Card 3 'Side controls' (an image with a floating emerald-500 ctrl-glow round next arrow pinned right-center).

Inside the max-w-7xl column (py-16), a 12-col grid (gap-12). LEFT (lg:col-span-4): an emerald-600 11px uppercase eyebrow 'Under the hood' over a slate-900 2xl/3xl font-extrabold 'Built to behave', a slate-500 text-sm leading-relaxed paragraph about keyboard-nav, reduced-motion, and sensible defaults, and a wrap of three rounded-full slate-200-bordered white chips 'React' / 'Tailwind' / 'a11y'. RIGHT (lg:col-span-8): a 2x2 feature-card grid (1 -> sm:2, gap-5). Each card is a rounded-2xl white card with a slate-200 border that turns emerald-200 + gains a peek shadow on hover, holding a 10x10 rounded-xl emerald-50 tile with an emerald-600 Phosphor-bold icon, a slate-900 text-sm font-bold title, and a slate-500 text-sm leading-relaxed body: 'Arrow-key nav' (ph:keyboard-bold), 'Touch + drag' (ph:hand-swipe-left-bold), 'Lazy + responsive' (ph:gauge-bold), and 'Reduced motion' (ph:eye-bold, with an inline slate-100 kbd chip 'prefers-reduced-motion').

prompts.partPt: Prompt Chamada Final para Ação + Rodapé
prompts.prompt: CTA: inside the max-w-7xl column (pb-24), a relative overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] slate-900 card, px-6/py-14 -> sm:px-12, centered, with two blurred emerald glows (emerald-500/20 top-right, emerald-400/10 bottom-left). Centered max-w-2xl content: a white 3xl/4xl font-extrabold 'Ship this carousel in one prompt', a slate-300 base leading-relaxed sub, then a faux prompt-input bar: a max-w-xl rounded-2xl white/10-bordered white/5 backdrop-blur row holding a 9x9 rounded-lg emerald-500 tile with a white ph:sparkle-bold icon, a truncated slate-300 sample prompt ('"Hero image carousel, one active slide with adjacent peek, emerald controls..."'), and a primary emerald-500 'Copy' button (rounded-xl, white, hover:emerald-600, ph:copy-bold). Below, a slate-400 text-xs reassurance line 'Free to remix · No attribution required'. FOOTER: a slate-200 top border, contents in the max-w-7xl column (py-8), flex-col -> sm:flex-row, items-center justify-between, slate-500 text-sm: left = a 6x6 rounded-md emerald-500 tile (white ph:slideshow-bold) + a slate-700 font-semibold 'Carousel.Design'; center = 'A component from the prompt library.'; right = three slate-400 social icon links (ph:github-logo-bold, ph:twitter-logo-bold, ph:figma-logo-bold) that turn emerald-600 on hover.

special_ui_components.prompt: Center-stage + peek carousel: one large aspect-[16/9] active frame (rounded-[20px], soft 'slide' shadow, ring-1 ring-black/5) flanked by two narrow aspect-[3/4] w-13% peek frames at opacity-85 with a 'peek' shadow and a directional white/55 -> white/15 fade overlay so neighbors recede; the peeks hide under sm and the active frame goes full-width.

On-frame controls: a left prev arrow (white/90, backdrop-blur, slate-700, shadow-lg, hover -> emerald-500/white) and a right next arrow (emerald-500 fill, white, colored 'ctrl' glow, hover:emerald-600), both 11x11 rounded-full and vertically centered, plus a bottom gradient scrim (slate-900/45 -> transparent) carrying an in-image caption (emerald-300 eyebrow + white title) and a white/15 backdrop-blur 'heart 2.4k' like chip.
Stretched-pill dot indicators: a centered row of h-2 dots where inactive dots are w-2 rounded-full slate-300 and the active dot is stretched into a w-7 emerald-500 pill.
Thin progress bar: an h-1 rounded-full slate-200 track with a partial (60%) emerald-500 fill, sitting above the dots.

Five-up thumbnail strip: aspect-[16/10] rounded-lg thumbnails at opacity-60 with ring-1 ring-black/5 (hover -> full opacity); the active thumbnail is larger and carries a ring-2 ring-emerald-500 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-white.
Pinging live badge: a rounded-full emerald badge whose status dot is an animate-ping emerald-400/75 ring over a solid emerald-500 dot.

Soft shadow + glow system (never hard): a large 'slide' shadow on the active frame and hovered cards, a softer 'peek' shadow on peek frames and resting cards, a colored emerald 'ctrl' glow on primary/next controls, plus blurred emerald radial glows behind the hero and inside the dark CTA.
Faint dotted 'grain' backdrop: radial-gradient(rgba(15,23,42,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px) at 22px x 22px, layered behind the hero and inside the showcase canvas at reduced opacity.
Literal layout-preview cards: the 'Variants you can fork' cards render the actual layout they name (full-bleed overlay, center+peek mini-stage, side floating control) rather than generic thumbnails.
Faux prompt-input bar in the dark CTA: a white/5 backdrop-blur rounded-2xl row with an emerald sparkle tile, a truncated sample prompt, and an emerald 'Copy' button.

structured.special_notes: The whole point is RESTRAINT: light near-white surfaces, slate text, and a single emerald accent (emerald-500 #10b981) reserved for intent (brand dot, the next control, eyebrows, the progress fill, the active dot/thumbnail ring, and CTAs). Depth comes only from large SOFT shadows and blurred glows, never hard offset blocks; corners are generously rounded everywhere. The carousel reads as restrained because of three moves: exactly one large active frame, narrow peeks that recede via a white fade + reduced opacity, and controls that stay out of the way (the prev arrow is quiet white-glass, only the next arrow carries the emerald glow). The active state is signalled three ways at once (the stretched emerald dot, the 60% progress fill, and the ring-2 emerald thumbnail). Inter is the only typeface (300-900); eyebrows are 11px uppercase with 0.18em tracking in emerald-600; headings are extrabold tracking-tight and text-balance. Icons are exclusively Iconify Phosphor 'bold' weight. Built with Tailwind (CDN) using a custom emerald scale and the named shadows slide / peek / ctrl; the 'grain' texture and the slide track's 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) transition are defined in a small <style> block.
